description: Limitations dues aux inondations et à la glace is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vlaamse Waterweg NV. Limitations due to flooding and ice. Coverage: Vlaamse Waterweg NV. The portal shows the English title as "Limitations due to flooding and ice" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vlaamse Waterweg NV. Its keywords include Restrictions caused by flood and ice, vervoersnetwerken, europees, binnenwatervervoer. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
